form.category: Bubble tea / flavoured tea beverage, drunk on the go

tier_0_default.why: Cheaper, no detour. Most drink occasions resolve here.

tier_1_cheap_substitute.why: Cheapest cup on the island, positioned where students pass.

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same product, same occasion. 62+ brands, 953 businesses islandwide. Fragmented.

members: CHAGEE - 'not a bubble tea brand, a tea expert'
tier_3_category_incumbent.why: The buyer is shopping for a TREAT DRINK. Each holds a rung of the mental ladder.

tier_4_adjacent_crossover.why: Takes the same treat-drink occasion with a different product.

tier_6_indirect.why: Dilutes the number of treat occasions.

members: Molly Tea (Shenzhen, flagship Orchard Central Mar 2026)
tier_7_new_entrants.why: Derived from ACRA/new-opening records, not asked of the owner.

derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Bubble tea / flavoured tea beverage, drunk on the go), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: wide (S$1.50-5.50, 267%). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
